name: qa_looper
title: OS-LOOPER L1 and L2c, Record: LOOP = 2 BARS on the RESAMPLE page (TAP MASTER) records two bars of t-v16 on the bars, the loop plays in time (also across a Stop and a Play), mutes with F8, is not recorded into a RESAMPLE take, overdubs a layer (F1: on, off), undoes it (F5), saves as a LOOP FWD instrument (SAVE, with a session on: the two-step save). Edits the loaded project in RAM only, the new instrument is not saved to the card

steps.note: (a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is Back)

steps.say: OS-LOOPER L1 (docs/specs/OS-LOOPER.md section 3a; rows QA-REC-020..027 of docs/qa/catalogue/record.md): the RESAMPLE page records what the engine plays, so the take is two bars of the song and the loop is audible against it

steps.note: RESAMPLE: TAP, START ON, STOP AT, LOOP
TAP, START ON, STOP AT, LOOP
LOOP = 2 BARS: START ON reads BAR and STOP AT reads LOOP, both dim
(the cpu counters are since boot or since this reset)

steps.say: the take is made of the song itself: Play, then F1 arms the loop take, which starts on the next bar and ends by itself after exactly two bars

steps.note: up to one bar to the start (2 s at 120 BPM) and two bars (4 s)
REVIEW - LOOP 2 BARS in the header, LOOP VOL in place of the trim rows, F1 OVERDUB dim, F8 LOOP ON

steps.say: by ear: the loop plays with the song, the same two bars on the bars, no flam against the pattern; it stays in time for a minute

steps.note: the loop's cost is the difference of the cpu line with and without it (docs/specs/OS-LOOPER.md, budget row 0.5 %): read it, then F4 and read it again for the same song
MUTED: the loop is silent and keeps its place
LOOP ON: back, on the bar where the bars have it

steps.say: a Stop fades the loop out, a Play starts it again at its beginning on the first bar

OS-LOOPER L2c (rows QA-REC-028..031): F1 under the loop's review is OVERDUB. On the RESAMPLE page it layers what the master plays (before the loop is added: no self-recording) onto the loop where it plays; the header reads ... - OVERDUB

steps.note: header REVIEW - LOOP 2 BARS - OVERDUB, card OVERDUB: LAYERING, F1 lit
a little more than two passes of the loop (4 s each at 120 BPM): every frame is written at least once
OVERDUB off: the input and the feedback ramp out over 32 frames, no click

steps.say: by ear: the layer plays from the next pass exactly on the layer under it (both carry the same lag: this is a layer on a layer, not against the bars, which is L4), no click where it began or ended

steps.note: the overdub's cost is read in the paired windows of the gate (docs/specs/OS-LOOPER.md 3c.7), not here
UNDO LYR: the loop fades out, the changed blocks are copied back a few every block, it fades in on its next restart (header - UNDO meanwhile)

steps.say: by ear: the loop is as it was before the overdub, back on its bar, no click at the undo; F5 again says NO LAYER TO UNDO
a second layer, then SAVE with the session still on (QA-REC-030): the review stays drawn for a frame or two, the loop is saved as heard

steps.note: SAVE: the session ends, then the loop becomes an instrument in the first free slot, the loop stops

steps.say: the new instrument LOOP 2B: Wave or Instrument shows play mode LOOP FWD over the whole sample, exactly two bars (about 4.0 s at 120 BPM); a pad plays it in a loop

finally.note: (a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is Back)
